name: Anchoring Bias
axiom: An initial number pulls later estimates toward it, even when it is arbitrary.
trigger: A suggested price, quantity, or budget shifts what people choose.
checklist: Remove arbitrary defaults before asking for an estimate.
Show a reference range the evidence supports, not a number near the answer.
Test the same question with and without a starting figure.

antiPattern.violation: A donation field prefilled with the highest tier lifts every gift.
antiPattern.remediation: The field starts empty and offers a range with its basis.

academicOrigin.title: Judgment under Uncertainty: Heuristics and Biases
